Morgan: Quick sync  Need a short one-pager + launch post for Secure Deploy (VPC & on-prem). Must include SLA snapshot, inbound routing fields, benchmark headline, and webinar CTA.

Diego: Ill draft the AE pocket guide and routing checklist (short bullets).

Priya: Ill pull numbers from the latest quantized L2-13b CSV and write a 2-sentence benchmark. Will keep it conservative and include a footnote.

Ava: Ill build the HubSpot form. Proposed fields: deployment_choice, compliance_needs, data_residency_region, priority_sla.

HubSpotBot: form created -> secure-deploy-interest-3999 ; utm_campaign=secure-deploy-launch :white_check_mark:

Priya: Draft stat: "Dedicated configs deliver ~2x steady throughput and ~1.4x lower cost per token vs Hosted for sustained production workloads (quantized L2-13b)." Footnote: test harness and seq distribution included in doc.

LegalBot: Marketing note: avoid absolute uptime claims. Use "SLA-backed" and link to SLA terms. Compliance blurb approved: "Supports SOC2 and ISO-aligned controls; Private/on-prem available for strict residency or regulatory needs."

Diego: AE cheat-sheet plan: headline pitch (1-2 lines), 3 qualifying Qs, routing rules: if deployment_choice==Private OR compliance_needs contains HIPAA -> Enterprise AE queue; if priority_sla -> tag `urgent` + notify SEs.

Morgan: Webinar: Wed 9am PT (preferred) or Thu 1pm PT. Format: 25m demo + 20m Q&A workshop. CTA: "Schedule Secure Deploy Workshop" + "Join webinar" RSVP.

Ava: I'll wire form -> HubSpot -> AE queues and add hidden campaign tags for tracking. Will pilot with two AEs next week.

Priya: Will add small stat table (Latency p95, Cost per 1M tokens) Hosted vs Dedicated and attach footnote.

Morgan: Deadlines: first drafts by EOD tomorrow. Review scheduled 10:30am PT day after. Keep copy conservative and field-ready. Ping here if blocked. :rocket: :calendar:
